review.headline: Easy 10 km done at a steady 5:44/km, inside the 5:11-6:13 easy band and conversational.
observations: Distance 10.01 km against 10.0 planned, all ten km splits at 5:44/km with no drift.
Average HR 140 (max 143), in line with recent easy runs at 138-142 bpm.
Pace sits in the middle-to-slow part of the easy band, which fits the relaxed purpose of the session.
Cadence 174 spm, consistent with previous runs.
flags: RPE and athlete note not logged for this run, so perceived effort is unknown.
Week 2 is at 16 km of 45 planned, and the last 7 days include a short-cut tempo (6 of planned km, called at RPE 8 with a note about heavy legs); keep an eye on recovery.
